items.item: fresh dill or frozen dill cubes

instructions: Make the dill dip: combine the mayo, dill, lemon juice, garlic, honey, Himalayan salt, and pepper.
Sprinkle the salmon with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Schmear the dill dip over the fish.
Bake at 400°F (375°F convection) until the internal temperature reaches 125°F at the thickest part.
notes: Text submission. '1 cups of mayo' kept as 1 cup. Cook time is estimated: the source gives only a target internal temperature (125°F at the thickest part); salmon at 400°F typically reaches it in about 12–15 minutes. Prep reasoning: 5 base + chop dill 2 + measure lemon juice 1 + garlic 4 cloves 1.75 + measure honey 1 + scoop mayo 1 + measure salt/pepper 1 + mix dip 1 + season salmon 1 + schmear 1 = 15.75 → 20. Servings default 4 for a main-course fish recipe (salmon quantity not stated).
title: Dill Dip Salmon
